event_name: Document 39 Date 01 December 2019 Time 18:21 2019 ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 28 November - 1 December 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between car 99 and car 88 in turn 12.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, and determined that no driver was wholly or predominantly to blame.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 88 Incident With Car 99 In Turn 12
to: The Team Manager, ROKiT Williams Racing
